blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Far Eastern University-DN Steel avoided another collapse, fending off Surabaya Samator of Indonesia in five sets, 25-22, 23-25, 25-23, 22-25, 15-11, to enter the win column in the Spikers’ Turf Invitational Conference semifinals on Wednesday at FilOil EcoOil Centre in San Juan. Licking the wounds of their heartbreaking five-set loss to Savouge on Monday, the Tamaraws hung tight with Mikko Espartero coming to the rescue, this time, to tie the Indonesians at 1-1 and keep their final hopes alive. Espartero unleashed 28 points off 22 kills, four blocks, and two aces to go with 20 excellent receptions. READ: […]...
